issues.problem: Going from $394.3B to $383.3B is a drop of about 2.8%, not 10.8%. The 10.8% figure also doesn't fit the word 'modest' used in the same sentence.

data.summary: The analysis has one error: revenue fell about 2.8%, not 10.8%. Every other figure matches Apple's reported FY2023 and FY2022 results.
